title: DE-3/2025/A2 - Departmental Examination for Junior Members of I.A.S., I.P.S. and I.F.S. - July, 2024 - Division 'B2' (Lower Standard) - Criminal Procedure Code 1973 (Act of 1974) [without books-30, with books-90]
questions: (Part A) 1. Define and distinguish Suspension and Remission of sentence.
(Part A) 2(a) Write short notes: First Information Report
(Part A) 3. Briefly state the rights of arrested person under Cr. P. C.
(Part A) 4. Explain the procedure for trial before a Court of Sessions.
(Part B) 5. Distinguish between a cognizable offence and a non-cognizable offence.
(Part B) 6. Distinguish between summary trial and warrant trial.
(Part B) 7. What is the difference between acquittal and discharge?
(Part B) 8. Explain the hierarchy of Criminal Courts in India and their jurisdiction.
(Part B) 9. What is a private complaint? Discuss the procedure to be followed on receipt of a private complaint.
(Part B) 10. Explain in details the principles of fair trial.
(Part B) 11. Examine the procedure for ensuring the presence of accused in a criminal trial.
(Part B) 12. Critically analyze the significance of including section 125 under Code of Criminal Procedure. Who are entitled to claim maintenance and on what grounds?
